works.title: Silicon Valley Brief: AI Agent Teams Disruption Thesis
works.description: A strategic white paper examining how AI agent teams will inevitably disrupt knowledge work across professional services, creative industries, and other sectors, framed through Silicon Valley's disruption mindset and historical patterns of industry transformation.
